settings.words_all_desc: Off: your words do only low-risk things (accepting research and writing, keeping an idea, running a routine once), each with a few seconds to undo. Everything else waits for your click on its card.
settings.words_all_on: On for this squad: your own words decide high-risk requests too. Each is read back and waits for your yes; what can't be taken back counts down 10 s first. Only this Mac's screens change it — never a phone or a message.
settings.words_ask_desc: What changes: merging, pushing, deploying, paying, sending for you and team changes can then be done by your words. equipe reads back exactly what will happen — the action, the ticket or branch, the recipient — with what a member wrote quoted as theirs, and your next message must be a clear yes; any “no” or “not yet” leaves it on its card, a yes with more said is asked again, and anything else goes to the member as usual. Said aloud or dictated, a yes must be short and on its own. What can't be taken back then waits 10 seconds for a “cancel”. Only what you type or dictate here counts — never a member's message, a quote or a paste. Every decision is logged, with your exact words, for 90 days so you can see where words went wrong; you can delete the log. “Always allow” and wider settings stay on their cards. Phones keep cards for anything above low risk.

desktop_setup.sharing_steps:
To unlock {host} from here, turn on Screen Sharing on that Mac once:
1. At {host}, open System Settings › General › Sharing.
2. Switch on "Screen Sharing".
3. Come back here and press "Check again" — equipe then opens Screen Sharing for you.
Only that Mac's user can switch it on. equipe never sees or stores your password.
